name: Albanella (Italy)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Albanella (two cypresses beneath stars on blue) within branches, with the inscription COMUNE DI ALBANELLA in grey arched above.
history: The arms, gonfalone and flag were approved by the municipal council on 28 December 2012 and then granted by decree of the President of the Republic.

features.role: Albanella arms — two cypresses beneath stars on blue, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI ALBANELLA arched above the arms
